title: [Master] - Slice 640938: [Expense Agent][VENDOR] Adding approval limits (November '26)
summary: The Expense Agent gains approval limits. New fields on User Setup and Expense User hold the limits, and the approval management codeunit now takes them into account when approving expense reports. Upgrade code and new interim approval tests are included.
key_points: Approval limit fields added to the User Setup table extension and the Expense User table
The fields are shown on the Approval User Setup page extension, the Expense User page and the Expense Users API
Expense Report Approval Mgmt updated to use the limits during approval
Expense report and manager pages, and the Expense Report Header table, adjusted
Upgrade codeunit extended, and a large interim approval test suite added
